usecase:
useCase
  actor "Customer" as C
  actor "Technician" as T
  external "Bank Server" as S
  system "ATM System" {
    usecase "Withdraw Cash" as UC1
    usecase "Check Balance" as UC2
    usecase "Login" as UC3
  }
  C --> UC1; UC2
  T --> UC3
  include: UC1 --> UC3
  dependency: UC1 --> S

pert_aoa:
pert
  type:aoa
  activity: 1-2, 2-3, 2-4, 3-5, 4-5
  optimistic: 2, 5, 1, 3, 2
  likely: 4, 7, 2, 4, 3
  pessimistic: 6, 9, 3, 5, 4
sequence:
sequence
  participant User as U
  participant actor Server as S
  participant Database as DB

  U -> S: Sync call
  S --> U: Reply
  U ->> S: Async fire
  S -->> U: Async reply
  U ->x S: Destroy

  loop Every 5 min
    U -> S: Heartbeat
    S --> U: Pong
  end

  alt Happy path
    S -> DB: Save
  else Error path
    S --> U: 500 Error
  end

  opt If logged in
    U -> S: Get Profile
  end

  note left of U: User is waiting
  note right of S, DB: Both involved
